update.title: Built a desktop soundboard
update.summary: Turned more than 250 clips into a searchable GTK soundboard for desktop playback, with an optional virtual-microphone route for voice chat.

preview.description: Soundboard window showing a searchable grid of image-backed sound cards

blocks.body:
## Make a large sound library usable

I turned a folder of more than 250 audio clips into a searchable grid of sound cards. Drag-and-drop imports, custom names, and cropped thumbnails make each sound quick to recognize and play without digging through filenames.

blocks.description: Soundboard window showing a searchable grid of image-backed sound cards. Search, tabs, output status, and Stop All keep the desktop library easy to navigate and control.

blocks.body:
## Add voice chat as another output

The soundboard plays clips through the desktop speakers, but it can also send them to a virtual microphone. Speaker and microphone outputs can be enabled independently and given separate volume levels, so a sound can stay local, go into voice chat, or do both. Overlap support and Stop All keep playback manageable when several clips are triggered.

blocks.code:
flowchart LR
  Card[Play a sound] --> Speakers[Desktop speakers]
  Card -. Optional route .-> Mic[Virtual microphone]
  Mic --> Chat[Voice chat]
blocks.description: Voice-chat routing extends the desktop soundboard without changing how the local library is used.
